coordinatorObservation.source: main's ProductUsageObservation over the controlled two-project product data
coordinatorObservation.days30: same facts inside both windows; window length differs only
coordinatorObservation.fAdmission: admitted for the declared projects, refused for a project outside the scope

findingsForMain: The coordinator folds a partial row (review.activeMs) into the header coverageState, so a completely enumerated source is served as 'partial'. G keeps source coverage and row coverage separate in its own projection; main may want the header to describe enumeration only.
Metric ids from the coordinator end with a trailing '@' when no currency is present (e.g. execution.durationMs@controlled@). Cosmetic, but a UI key comparison would need to tolerate it.

reader: missing evidence is partial with null header sample
reader error text never reaches the DTO
window start counts and end does not
dto: one row per layer and per currency
unknown usage stays null and no cost row is invented
partial proxy detail next to a complete source
current attention is not part of the DTO
report: canary in raw detail never printed
no percentage or saved-hours claim without a baseline
package: console never imports the Node package
browser entry has no node: builtin

notReached: actual_native execution data: NOT_TESTED — the controlled fixture driver ran; no vendor model or native turn was performed
operator production instance: NOT_ATTEMPTED — main's reader is the production path and G did not read a user instance
real operator baseline: none supplied; no comparison is produced
installed package with observation entry: the current 1cd package has none; installed scope is D's to freeze and is not claimed from source progress
7/30-day history on real operator data: only controlled data spanning minutes was available; long-window absence is reported as unknown, not as a complete zero
long-running stability and cross-machine performance: out of scope
limitations: All numbers are observations of recorded facts. Nothing here proves saved hours, efficiency gains, causality or quality.
review.activeMs is a partial UI-visibility proxy, never human working time.
Interaction metrics are product-record counts and carry no evidence layer.
Unknown usage and cost stay unknown; currencies are never combined and prices are not looked up.
Decimals are formatted by the coordinator to one fraction digit; G's report keeps up to three and they agree within 0.05.
A bundle keeps product record detail and diagnostic text and is a private 0600 input; only reports are sanitized.
